mapper.select: select e.*, u.user_name, u.status account_status, u.dept_id, d.dept_name, s.site_name, s.status site_status from att_employee e join sys_user u on u.user_id=e.user_id and u.del_flag='0' left join sys_dept d on d.dept_id=u.dept_id join att_site s on s.site_id=e.site_id where e.user_id=#{userId}
select * from att_employee where user_id=#{userId} for update
select * from att_employee where employee_id = #{id} for update
select count(*) from att_employee where user_id = #{id}
select count(*) from att_employee where (employee_no = #{no} or user_id = #{userId}) and employee_id != #{id}
